name: outcome
description: The result of the booking availability call. Choose the single most accurate value based on the entire conversation. CONFIRMED = venue said the slot is available (fee or free). DECLINED = venue said the slot is not available. ALTERNATIVE_OFFERED = venue suggested a different date or time. IVR_NAVIGATION_FAILED = agent reached an automated phone menu and could not reach a human after 3 navigation attempts. UNCLEAR = any other result: voicemail reached without leaving a message, no answer, confusing response, call dropped before a clear answer.
